message.content:
This is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 in the parser. The off-by-one fix at line 492 in `Parser::Next()` reads `cursor_[4]` when it should read `cursor_[3]`. This is exactly a READ 1 heap-buffer-overflow. When the input ends with `+inf` or `-inf` at the very end of the buffer, `cursor_[4]` reads one byte past the end.
